description: Default checks run on every ticket's page, whether or not the acceptance criteria mention them. Keep page-specific acceptance criteria in each ticket's tests instead.

cases.title: Page loads without browser or first-party request errors
cases.covers: Successful page response, uncaught JavaScript errors, and failed same-origin resources.

cases.title: Shared navigation links have working destinations
cases.covers: Visible navigation links have destinations and same-origin pages respond successfully.

cases.title: Visible links and controls are usable
cases.covers: Interactive controls have accessible names, links have destinations, and keyboard focus can reach controls.

cases.title: Basic page accessibility checks pass
cases.covers: Images have alt attributes and headings follow a sensible order.

cases.title: Forms show validation without submitting real data
cases.covers: When a form exists, submitting invalid or empty required fields shows validation and does not create records or send messages.

cases.title: Page has no horizontal overflow at common viewport sizes
cases.covers: The page remains within the viewport at desktop, tablet, and mobile widths.

cases.title: Async form actions do not submit twice on a rapid double click
cases.covers: For an available POST form, rapid repeat clicks do not launch duplicate writes. Test requests are blocked before reaching the server.

cases.title: Tables show a no-data state when their list is empty
cases.covers: When the page has a table, its list requests are emptied in the browser only (no server data is changed) and the table must show an empty-state message.
